name: Form layout and field widths
explanation: Arranging a form in a single column with labels above the fields, and making each field about as wide as the answer it expects.
synonyms: form design;field widths;single column form;label placement
triggers: lay out a form;labels above fields;fields too wide;form looks messy;two column form;how wide should fields be
requirements: Put fields in a single column in a logical order;Put labels above fields, not beside them or as placeholder text;Make each field about as wide as the expected answer, such as a short field for a postcode;Group related fields, such as an address, in a fieldset with a legend;Keep hint text between the label and the field;Put the main action after the last field, aligned with the fields;Make fields full width on small screens so nothing scrolls sideways
done_when: The form reads top to bottom in one column on every screen size;Field widths hint at the expected answer;The form works at 400 percent zoom without sideways scrolling
